curriculum_nodes.title: Backhand Impact Foundation
tips: Use your non-dominant hand on the racquet throat to initiate the unit turn.
Step across with your front foot and freeze your posture at the contact point.
Keep your wrist firm and meet the ball well in front of your lead hip.

drill_spec.title: Impact Point Wall Press
drill_spec.instruction: Place racket against a wall at ideal contact height, holding straight-arm posture for 5 seconds.

curriculum_nodes.title: Forehand Spacing & Extension
tips: Create space from the ball by using your off-hand as a distance finder.
Swing low-to-high and fully extend through the contact zone before wrapping the finish.
Transfer your weight onto your front foot just before making contact.

drill_spec.title: Self-Drop Extension Drill
drill_spec.instruction: Drop ball 2 feet in front; step forward and drive through contact with relaxed elbow extension.

curriculum_nodes.title: One-Handed Backhand Drive
tips: Drop the racquet head below the ball prior to starting your forward swing.
Spread your chest open at the finish by pulling your non-dominant arm backward for counterbalance.
Stay down through the shot and avoid lifting your head until the ball crosses the net.

drill_spec.title: Impact Point Wall Press
drill_spec.instruction: Place racket against a wall at ideal contact height, holding straight-arm posture for 5 seconds.

curriculum_nodes.title: Baseline Wing Transitions
tips: Use your non-dominant hand on the racquet throat during recovery to quickly change grips.
Execute a crisp split-step just as your hitting partner prepares to strike the ball.
Maintain a consistent rally tempo by aiming three feet above the net cord on both wings.

curriculum_nodes.title: Social Match Play Patterns
tips: Direct your one-handed backhand deep cross-court to stay in high-percentage rallies.
Look for short balls in the middle of the court to attack with your modern forehand.
Focus on smooth footwork and high net clearance during friendly practice sets.
